# Feature: Receipts

## Summary
Every paid order gets an emailed receipt with correct totals.

## User stories
1. As a customer, I get a receipt email within a minute of paying.
2. As a customer, the receipt's totals match what I paid, to the cent.

## Requirements
- FR-010: Send a receipt email after a successful payment.
- FR-011: Totals are computed in integer cents (constitution I).
